ordering_guarantee.written_while: Stage 1 still running at 537/630 episodes; no Stage-3 outcome exists
ordering_guarantee.benchmark_excluded: the 15-episode operational benchmark must NOT influence anchor selection; it is operational benchmarking, not a sampling frame

why.problem: The first C3 attempt hit ABORTED_OPERATIONAL_SCALE at Stage 3: exhaustive per-anchor counterfactual branching over the full legal team-response product made wall-clock operationally unbounded.
why.insight: The frozen aggregate gate is a RATE (fork_rate = n_qualified_commitment_forks / n_pressure_anchors, threshold 0.20), not an enumeration. A rate is estimable from a sample with quantifiable precision, so exhaustive evaluation buys precision far beyond the decision boundary at combinatorial cost.
why.what_does_not_change: the estimand, the criterion, and every scientific cell

legal_response_enumeration_stays_exhaust.rule: Within every sampled anchor, the full cartesian product of per-agent legal macros is still enumerated.
legal_response_enumeration_stays_exhaust.why: top2_policy_actions_forbidden and hand_curated_subset_forbidden are anti-cherry-picking rules. Sampling responses would let us test only the alternatives we already believe in — exactly how a named strategy such as ESCORT would smuggle itself back in. Anchors are sampled; responses never are.
legal_response_enumeration_stays_exhaust.cost_effect: cost falls linearly with the anchor count while the anti-bias guarantee is preserved intact

sampling_design.rationale: Guarantees every policy/opponent cell is examined, so no single adversary or seed can dominate the screen.
sampling_design.precision_at_target: SE of a proportion near p=0.20 at n=210 is about 0.028, giving a 95% interval near +/-0.055 — sufficient to separate 0.20 from a materially larger rate, which is the only decision this screen makes.
sampling_design.expected_stage3_cost: ~6 hours at benchmark timing, against ~70 hours exhaustive

sampling_seed.why_derived_not_chosen: Deriving the seed from the frozen contract's own hash makes anchor selection impossible to massage after the fact: the seed is a function of a document that predates it and cannot be changed without changing the hash.

low_count_fallback.rule: If a stratum holds fewer than 10 anchors, take all available anchors in that stratum and redistribute the deficit deterministically among strata that still have unused anchors.
low_count_fallback.redistribution_order: strata sorted ascending by (policy_seed, opponent); deficit assigned round-robin over strata with remaining unused anchors
low_count_fallback.timing: resolved from the Stage-1 census BEFORE any Stage-3 outcome is inspected
low_count_fallback.why: Prevents a thin stratum from silently shrinking the sample, and fixes the repair rule in advance so it cannot be tuned once fork outcomes are visible.

estimator.problem_with_naive_rate: qualified/210 unweighted would change the estimand: strata contain different numbers of natural pressure anchors, so equal allocation over-weights rare cells relative to the natural anchor population.
estimator.weights: W_h = N_h / N, where N_h is the COMPLETE Stage-1 anchor count for stratum h and N is the total across all strata
estimator.point_estimate: p_hat = sum_h W_h * p_hat_h, where p_hat_h is the fork rate observed among the sampled anchors of stratum h
estimator.estimand: the fork rate of the NATURAL anchor population, not of the sample

uncertainty.why_clustered: several anchors can come from one trajectory and are not independent observations; resampling anchors directly would understate the interval
uncertainty.stratified: resample episodes within each stratum, then recompute the weighted estimate with the frozen W_h

decision_rule.note: The decision is on the lower bound, not the point estimate. Under sampling, a point estimate above 0.20 with an interval straddling it is not a pass.
